facts.fact: Graphic Online reports the Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, ran a field enforcement exercise in Accra on 12 October 2026 under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

GHA.note: Referrals to police are not a ruling; registration count is not a count of rulings.

facts.fact: The Executive Director said 14 years after passage of the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), whose Section 56 makes processing without registration punishable on summary conviction.
The Commission's Executive Director and Director of Regulatory and Compliance briefed the press and led the enforcement exercise.

The Commission reported 2,575 data controller registrations in 2026, found two hospitals with expired certificates, and referred a microfinance firm and a clinic to police, with no decision of its own stated.
The Commission enforces the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), which the Executive Director said was passed 14 years ago.
The Commission's Executive Director and Director of Regulatory and Compliance are acting in post and ran the 12 October 2026 exercise.
The Commission recorded 2,575 controller registrations in 2026 and inspected organisations' registration status and data handling, finding expired certificates.
